import sys
import os
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from data_utils import get_eval_dataset
from predictor import PredictorWrapper
from lm_eval_sparse_uniform import teal_masks, _uniform_topk_masks

MODEL_PATH = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/qwen2.5-14b"
PREDICTOR_PATH = "/root/distill_sparse_swiglu/checkpoints/qwen14b_kl30_s42/predictor_kl_normalized.pt"
DEVICE = "cuda:1"
SPARSITY_TARGET = 0.301
CALIB_SAMPLES = 8
SEQ_LEN = 2048

def main():
    device = torch.device(DEVICE)
    print(f"Loading model from {MODEL_PATH} ...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_PATH,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        device_map={"": device},
        attn_implementation="sdpa",
    )
    model.eval()

    print(f"Loading predictor from {PREDICTOR_PATH} ...")
    wrapper = PredictorWrapper(model, bottleneck_size=128)
    ckpt = torch.load(PREDICTOR_PATH, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
    wrapper.predictors.load_state_dict(ckpt["predictors"])
    wrapper.predictors.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    wrapper.predictors.eval()
    wrapper.gumbel_mask.hard = True

    print("Loading calibration data (WikiText-2) ...")
    calib_data = get_eval_dataset("wikitext2", tokenizer, SEQ_LEN)
    n_calib = min(CALIB_SAMPLES, len(calib_data))
    calib_ids = torch.stack([calib_data[i]["input_ids"] for i in range(n_calib)]).to(device)
    print(f"  Using {n_calib} calibration sequences")

    print(f"Computing masks (uniform, sparsity={SPARSITY_TARGET}) ...")
    masks = teal_masks(wrapper, calib_ids, SPARSITY_TARGET, allocation="uniform", calib_batch_size=4)

    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"Per-layer sparsity (target={SPARSITY_TARGET}):")
    print(f"{'='*50}")
    all_ok = True
    for idx in sorted(masks):
        sp = 1.0 - masks[idx].float().mean().item()
        status = "OK" if abs(sp - SPARSITY_TARGET) < 0.02 else "FAIL"
        if status == "FAIL":
            all_ok = False
        print(f"  Layer {idx:2d}: {sp:.4f}  [{status}]")

    total_n = sum(m.numel() for m in masks.values())
    total_z = sum((m == 0).sum().item() for m in masks.values())
    model_sp = total_z / total_n
    print(f"\n  Model-level sparsity: {model_sp:.4f}")
    print(f"  Total layers: {len(masks)}")
    print(f"\n  RESULT: {'ALL PASS' if all_ok else 'SOME LAYERS FAILED'}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
